snippet.title: The Last Captain - First Look
snippet.description:
#TheLastCaptain #scifi #rpg 

Welcome to the exciting world of The Last Captain, an upcoming space shooter RPG. Check out how combat works, what the game's about, and footage from our first multiplayer beta!

Find out more at https://www.lastcaptaingame.com
Wishlist at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700200/The_Last_Captain
